title: Hope for the unprotected
explanation: The saying expresses faith that someone without protection may still find help. It offers reassurance, not a reason to withhold practical assistance.
meaning_odia: ଅସହାୟ ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ସହାୟତା ମିଳିପାରେ ବୋଲି ଆସ୍ଥା ଓ ଆଶ୍ୱାସ ଏଠାରେ ପ୍ରକାଶ ପାଏ।
usage_example: Neighbours reassure a stranded traveller while arranging help. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: A statement of faith, not a guaranteed outcome.
